auth.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. Leave blank the first time, before you've set it up.
auth.failedWithCode: That didn’t work. Check your email, password and authenticator code. After 5 failed tries, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.failed: That email and password didn’t work. After 5 failed tries, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes.

formErrors.invalid: This doesn't look right. Please check it.
formErrors.httpsOnly: Use a full web address starting with https://
formErrors.mustAgree: Please read and accept the agreement to continue.

errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait an hour and try again.
errors.invalidLink: This link has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, we've sent a reset link. It works for 1 hour. Check your spam folder too.

resend.title: Resend confirmation email
resend.intro: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send a new confirmation link.
resend.sent: If that email is waiting to be confirmed, we've sent a new link. Check your spam folder too.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You've been signed out on other devices.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.intro: Press the button to confirm your email address.
verify.done: Thanks! Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
